signals.headline: Flood advisory in effect until 18:00
signals.meansForYou: Water over roadways on the usual low-lying routes. If your evacuation route runs through one, the alternate is the one to use today.

signals.headline: Air quality index 112 — unhealthy for sensitive groups
signals.meansForYou: Anyone in the household with asthma or a heart condition should stay indoors with the windows shut. An N95 helps outdoors; a surgical mask does not.

signals.headline: No events above M2.5 within 100 km in the last 24 hours
